input:
On an LPDDR6-based SoC with TrustZone, we see this EL3 abort in the boot log:

  [EL3] DRAM access fault, VA=0x80100000, MRI region=2, op=Normal-World-write
  [EL3] Panic: MRI violation; halting

LPDDR6 introduces Memory Region Isolation (MRI). The bootloader (ATF BL2) programs the MRI table before handing off to BL33. Walk through the diagnostic flow: where is the MRI table configured, how does it interact with the device-tree /reserved-memory ranges, and what common misconfigurations cause overlap between Secure-World and Normal-World ranges?
